mrp_production_ingredients_brand_pair.name: mrp_production_ingredients_brand_pair
mrp_production_ingredients_brand_pair.value: ("mrp_production_ingredients"."ingredient_brand_id" is null and "mrp_production_ingredients"."ingredient_brand_name" is null) or ("mrp_production_ingredients"."ingredient_brand_id" is not null and "mrp_production_ingredients"."ingredient_brand_name" is not null)

mrp_stock_transactions_correlation.name: mrp_stock_transactions_correlation
mrp_stock_transactions_correlation.value: ("mrp_stock_transactions"."type" in ('production-consumption', 'production-output') and "mrp_stock_transactions"."production_id" is not null and "mrp_stock_transactions"."order_id" is null) or ("mrp_stock_transactions"."type" in ('entry', 'write-off') and "mrp_stock_transactions"."production_id" is null and "mrp_stock_transactions"."order_id" is null) or ("mrp_stock_transactions"."type" in ('sale', 'sale-cancellation') and "mrp_stock_transactions"."production_id" is null and "mrp_stock_transactions"."order_id" is not null)

pdv_discount_components_kind_fields_vali.name: pdv_discount_components_kind_fields_valid
pdv_discount_components_kind_fields_vali.value: ("pdv_discount_components"."kind" = 'portion' and "pdv_discount_components"."size_id" is not null and "pdv_discount_components"."brand_id" is null) or ("pdv_discount_components"."kind" = 'resale' and "pdv_discount_components"."size_id" is null)

pdv_order_discount_components_kind_field.name: pdv_order_discount_components_kind_fields_valid
pdv_order_discount_components_kind_field.value: ("pdv_order_discount_components"."kind" = 'portion' and "pdv_order_discount_components"."size_id" is not null and "pdv_order_discount_components"."brand_id" is null) or ("pdv_order_discount_components"."kind" = 'resale' and "pdv_order_discount_components"."size_id" is null)

pdv_order_lines_kind_fields_valid.name: pdv_order_lines_kind_fields_valid
pdv_order_lines_kind_fields_valid.value: ("pdv_order_lines"."kind" = 'portion' and "pdv_order_lines"."size_id" is not null and "pdv_order_lines"."size_name" is not null and "pdv_order_lines"."size_quantity" is not null and "pdv_order_lines"."brand_id" is null and "pdv_order_lines"."brand_name" is null) or ("pdv_order_lines"."kind" = 'resale' and "pdv_order_lines"."size_id" is null and "pdv_order_lines"."size_name" is null and "pdv_order_lines"."size_quantity" is null and (("pdv_order_lines"."brand_id" is null and "pdv_order_lines"."brand_name" is null) or ("pdv_order_lines"."brand_id" is not null and "pdv_order_lines"."brand_name" is not null)))

pdv_orders_channel_snapshot_complete.name: pdv_orders_channel_snapshot_complete
pdv_orders_channel_snapshot_complete.value: ("pdv_orders"."channel_id" is null and "pdv_orders"."channel_name" is null and "pdv_orders"."channel_percentage" is null) or ("pdv_orders"."channel_id" is not null and "pdv_orders"."channel_name" is not null and "pdv_orders"."channel_percentage" is not null)

pdv_orders_cancellation_complete.name: pdv_orders_cancellation_complete
pdv_orders_cancellation_complete.value: ("pdv_orders"."status" = 'registered' and "pdv_orders"."canceled_at" is null and "pdv_orders"."canceled_by" is null and "pdv_orders"."canceled_by_name" is null) or ("pdv_orders"."status" = 'canceled' and "pdv_orders"."canceled_at" is not null and "pdv_orders"."canceled_by" is not null and "pdv_orders"."canceled_by_name" is not null and length(btrim("pdv_orders"."canceled_by_name")) > 0)

pdv_order_stock_restorations_brand_snaps.name: pdv_order_stock_restorations_brand_snapshot_complete
pdv_order_stock_restorations_brand_snaps.value: ("pdv_order_stock_restorations"."brand_id" is null and "pdv_order_stock_restorations"."brand_name" is null) or ("pdv_order_stock_restorations"."brand_id" is not null and "pdv_order_stock_restorations"."brand_name" is not null and length(btrim("pdv_order_stock_restorations"."brand_name")) > 0)

events_reservation_consistency_check.name: events_reservation_consistency_check
events_reservation_consistency_check.value:
(
        ("events"."status" = 'publishing' AND "events"."reserved_by" IS NOT NULL AND "events"."reservation_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)
        OR
        ("events"."status" <> 'publishing' AND "events"."reserved_by" IS NULL AND "events"."reservation_expires_at" IS NULL)
      )
